pkgmetadata.longdescription: 3D Pinball Space Cadet Talking is a community fork of SpaceCadetPinball (the reverse-engineered Windows "3D Pinball for Windows - Space Cadet" game) by Creatiel. It adds voice announcements, animated artwork and gameplay refinements. This package repackages the prebuilt Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 .deb shipped upstream; it is not built from source.
